full_judgment:
11. The plaintiff filed the certified copies of khatian No. 292 whereas the contesting defendant filed different power of attorney, registered deeds and the certified copy of the judgment and plaint of preemption case No. 55 of 1972 and rent receipts which are marked Exhibit-Ka to Ta. 

 20. From the admitted position of this case, we can come to a conclusion that Babu Ram Singh was the owner of 4.48 acres of land in 13 plots of Khatian No. 292 of Modha Bhag Mouza under Kamolgonj Police Station, khatian marked as Exhibit 1 also proves such contention. 

 36. As regard the gift of 60 decimals of land out of plot No. 1675 in favour of Lakshmi Rani Debi, there is no material facts in the written statement to prove this point nor is there any evidence to prove this fact. Rather, the contesting defendant frankly concedes that khatian No. 566 and plot No. 1638 was wrongly inserted in place of khatian No. 292 and plot No. 1675. It is the provision of law that if any plot number is wrongly inserted in any deed it is to be corrected by the rectification deed. But the contesting defendant failed to execute any such deed. In the absence of such rectification deed or of any reliable evidence in this respect and in view of the plaintiffs' challenge in this respect, the deed of gift dated 8-12-1961 by Babu Ram Singh in favour of Lakshmi Rani Debi marked Exhibit 'Uma' cannot pass title to the vendee of the deed. Consequently, the defendant No.1 had acquired no title in 60 decimals of land on the basis of purchase deeds marked Exhibit 'Cha' and 'Chha' from Lakshmi Rani Debi because the vendee of deed marked Exhibit Uma was owner in respect of khatian No. 566 and plot No. 1637 but not in suit khatian No. 292 and plot No.1675 and thus the land of the deed of Lakshmi Rani Debi marked Exhibit 'Uma' does not attract the suit land.
